column1: # OpenAddresses sources whose definition states no licence (or none the classifier recognises)
# and that were read against the publisher's own terms (October 2026). The builder reads a file
# listed here as open; the second column is the licence or terms found, the third the party to
# credit, the fourth where they were read. A source that the classifier reads as restricted or
# share-alike is never overridden by this list. Not legal advice: re-read a source's terms before
# Read and not allowed (add one only after the publisher grants the use):
#   AZ statewide  "may not modify or alter this dataset without permission" (ADOA 9-1-1 Program)
#   RI statewide  "not intended for any other purpose" than RI E 9-1-1 mapping software
#   King County WA  "no one is permitted to sell this information" without a written agreement
#   Oregon Metro (RLIS), Spokane County WA, Bucks County PA, CAPCOG TX  limited, non-commercial or share-alike
#   Omaha NE  every distribution must carry the End User Agreement unaltered
#   Howard County MD  "public domain" is only the contributor's note; the county's terms were not found
#   WY statewide  a parcel viewer whose county sources state nothing
#   FL statewide (three files)  commercial vendors (Mapwise, Loveland) or no terms (Revenue); NH parcel points (vendor data)
#   WA, SC, IA, MO, MI statewide  contributor uploads of a state file; the state's terms were not found
#   AR, MD, DE, SD, AK, MS, ID, WV, TX statewide  no terms found
#   Outside the US (read, not allowed): South Korea (juso.go.kr), Iceland, Moscow, Riga, Bulgaria, Bern, Basel,
#   Solothurn, Geneva, Cape Town, eThekwini, Montevideo, Cape Breton (licence link dead), Cayman Islands (Crown
#   copyright, all rights reserved), Sao Paulo (CC-BY-SA), Fribourg (CC-BY-SA) and the Canadian cities whose terms
#   pages could not be read (BC, Alberta, Ontario and Quebec municipalities); ZA, SA, EG, BY, KZ, RU, TH, KW, XK, QA
#   and AE countrywide or city files are uploads or portals with no terms
#   files whose licence is only "Indemnification" or a presumed attribution say nothing about use
